cover.headline:
Same diet.
Less sleep.
[hl]Less than half[/hl]
the fat lost.

image.label: ai

polaroid.caption: Bedtime is part of the diet.

study.headline: Overweight adults dieted for 2 weeks, twice. Once with 8.5 hours in bed, once with 5.5.
study.note: Fat lost: 1.4 kg with 8.5 hours, 0.6 kg with 5.5. Lean mass lost: 1.5 kg vs 2.4 kg.
study.source: Nedeltcheva et al., Annals of Internal Medicine, 2010

image.label: ai
image.alt: Dark, cool bedroom with a made bed

exhibit_b.caption: Cool, dark, phone away.
exhibit_b.headline: Sleep is part of the diet.

verdict.headline:
Cut sleep and
you cut the
[y]fat you lose.[/y]
verdict.body: They were hungrier too. More of the weight they lost was lean mass, not fat.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan now in a white tank top, smiling

items: Give yourself 8.5 hours in bed when you diet.
Keep the room cool. I sleep best around 63 degrees.
